seed_and_data_provenance.seed_mechanism: jax.random.PRNGKey(seed=args.seed) at mbd_planner.py:40, the only source of randomness in the script; passed with the supported flag --seed 0
seed_and_data_provenance.data: No external dataset. The car2d environment is defined analytically in mbd/envs/car2d.py (RK4 kinematics, 11 circular obstacles, start [-0.5, 0, 3*pi/2], goal [0.5, 0]). The environment constructor also loads the bundled demonstration mbd/assets/car2d_xref.npy (car2d.py:66); with enable_demo False it does not enter the update.

reference_values.final_reward_precision_note: Upstream prints the final reward with three significant digits (mbd_planner.py:187) and does not save it; no higher-precision value exists in the evidence, so none is given.
reference_values.progress_bar: Every progress-bar refresh that carries a reward (107 in run1, 104 in run2, including the last one at 99/99) shows 'rew=0.00e+00', i.e. the mean reward of the 2048 sampled trajectories was displayed as zero at every reverse step.

replay_comparison.tolerance: none needed: the arrays are bitwise equal between the two runs on cuda:0 (same process configuration, same machine). No tolerance for other devices, drivers or JAX versions was measured.

replay_comparison.corroboration_outside_this_namespace: The coordinator's earlier feasibility run from the pinned checkout itself (tmp/env-probe/coord/car2d-default-out/, not this executor's evidence) has the same SHA-256 for mu_0ts.npy and rollout.png, so the private copy and the checkout produce identical files. Read-only observation; those files were not modified.

figures.description: A 300 x 300 px plot on axes x, y in [-2, 2] showing the eleven grey circular obstacles that form a U open to the left and, inside it, the red 'Car path' as a small cluster of points around the start position (about x = -0.5, y = 0): the car stays where it started, does not leave the U and does not approach the goal at (0.5, 0), which upstream does not draw.
figures.cosmetic_note: the x-axis label is cut off at the lower edge (figsize 3 x 3 inches without a tight layout)

scientific_observations: The final plan obtains zero reward: the printed value -1.19e-07 equals -2^-23 to the printed precision, which is one float32 rounding step below zero in the reward 1 - (clip(d, 0, 0.2) / 0.2)^2 of car2d.py:89-93 for a car farther than 0.2 from the goal. This reading of the number is an inference from the source, not a separately measured quantity.

The mean sample reward shown by the progress bar is 0.00e+00 at every refresh, so in this run no reward signal was displayed at any reverse step. This is the documented command without --enable_demo; the coordinator's probe note relates this outcome to the paper's data-free car2d case (its Figure 4(b)). The executor did not check the paper.
limitations: One seed (0), one environment (car2d), script defaults only; no other parameter combination was executed.
The final reward exists only as the three-significant-digit stdout value.
Bitwise reproducibility was established for two runs on this machine (RTX 4070 Laptop, driver 581.04, jax 0.4.30 CUDA 12); it is not evidence for other hardware or versions.
The combined stdout/stderr log is one file (the launcher's --log merges both streams); tqdm writes carriage returns, so the log must be read with CR translated to LF.
--enable_demo was not run under this assignment.
Wall time includes JIT compilation and differs between the runs (31 s and 17 s by launcher timestamps); the waiting time for the shared workspace lock (about 2 and 5 minutes) is not part of it.
